optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Fraud Analytics Analyst, Card Fraud Detection

professionalSummary.text: Three years of experience as a Fraud Analytics Analyst in a card issuer’s fraud detection team, responsible for analysing flagged transactions, proposing rule threshold changes, monitoring model precision, and coordinating with operations and model owners.
professionalSummary.witness: "Fraud analytics analyst in a card issuer's fraud detection team for three years, analysing flagged-transaction outcomes each week and proposing rule threshold changes with their expected alert volumes; the changes were approved by the fraud strategy manager."

experienceHighlights.text: Analyzed flagged-transaction outcomes weekly and proposed rule threshold changes with expected alert volumes, receiving approval from the fraud strategy manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: "analysing flagged-transaction outcomes each week and proposing rule threshold changes with their expected alert volumes; the changes were approved by the fraud strategy manager."

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly fraud performance packs detailing losses, alert volumes, false positive rates, and rule change impacts.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Prepared the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates and the effect of the month's rule changes."

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored fraud model alert precision weekly, identified two drift cases, and logged them with model owners.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Monitored the fraud model's alert precision on the weekly monitoring dashboard and raised two drift cases to the model owners, both recorded in the model monitoring log."

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated rule changes with the fraud operations desk, documenting responsibilities in change notes.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Coordinated each rule change with the fraud operations desk through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which belonged to the desk supervisor."

experienceHighlights.text: Authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each rule change note.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Wrote the limitation section of each rule change note and the hand-over conditions for the desk."

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a rule change proposal with expected alert volumes and approval record, a monthly fraud performance pack, and a model monitoring log extract for two drift cases as verifiable work samples.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: "Work sample: one rule change proposal with its expected alert volumes and approval record, one monthly fraud performance pack and the model monitoring log extract for the two drift cases, with the fraud tool references as a verification trail."

skills.text: Rule threshold analysis, alert volume estimation, fraud performance reporting, model precision monitoring, drift detection, change coordination, documentation of limitations and hand‑over procedures.
